save_rr_file: save a contact probability matrix as an RR format text file to disk
save_torsions: save torsion predictions as a pickled dictionary containing probabilities and sequence data
save_distance_histogram: save a distance histogram prediction matrix with range and bin metadata as a pickle file
save_distance_histogram_from_dict: save a distance histogram dictionary with validated fields as a binary pickle file
contact_map_from_distogram: compute a contact map from a distogram dictionary by splitting the boundary bin
